pronouns.get.description: Looks up the pronouns a Twitch viewer set on pronouns.alejo.io. Leave the user out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's Twitch login name, like "coolviewer42". Leave it out for the user of the trigger.

pronouns.get.returns: An object with display (like "She/Her"), subject, object, singular, altSubject and altObject. null when they set none or the site cannot be reached.
